implementation_notes: Added the nine FEAT-JARVIS-004 fields to JarvisConfig in src/jarvis/config/settings.py under a clearly delimited block, immediately after attended_adapter_ids and before model_config. Field declarations match docs/design/FEAT-JARVIS-004/contracts/API-internal.md §8: nats_url (str default 'nats://localhost:4222'), nats_credentials_path (Path | None default None), heartbeat_interval_seconds (int Field default=30 ge=5 le=300 per DDR-021/heartbeat), graphiti_endpoint (str | None default None — triggers DDR-019 soft-fail), graphiti_api_key (SecretStr | None default None), jarvis_traces_dir (Path default ~/.jarvis/traces), specialist_dispatch_timeout_seconds (int Field default=60 ge=5 le=600 per DDR-016), dispatch_concurrent_cap (int Field default=8 ge=1 le=64 per DDR-020), jarvis_agent_version (str Field default='0.4.0' pattern=r'^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[a-z0-9.]+)?$'). For the two field names that already start with 'jarvis_' (jarvis_traces_dir, jarvis_agent_version), used validation_alias=AliasChoices('JARVIS_TRACES_DIR', 'jarvis_traces_dir') and 'JARVIS_AGENT_VERSION' / 'jarvis_agent_version' so the friendlier env-var names resolve cleanly without the awkward double-JARVIS prefix that env_prefix='JARVIS_' would otherwise produce. Tests cover defaults, env-prefix resolution, ge/le boundary rejection on all three constrained fields, semver acceptance/rejection on jarvis_agent_version, and a static check that settings.py source has no nats/graphiti imports.
